title: AI Engineer Intern (x/f/m) - Paris
desc:
Join a team of passionate and committed people working to improve healthcare.

At Doctolib, our tech teams build products and features that improve the daily lives of healthcare professionals and patients. We work in feature teams within an agile environment, in close collaboration with Product, Design, Data Science, and Business teams.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern to join our Tech team and contribute to the development of AI-powered features at Doctolib.

You will work closely with experienced AI and software engineers to explore, prototype, evaluate, and improve AI-based solutions. This internship will give you the opportunity to gain practical experience across the different stages of an AI product, from experimentation to integration into a production environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Contribute to the development of AI features and services under the guidance of experienced engineers

 - Write Python code to support prototypes, experiments, evaluation tools, and backend components

 - Experiment with large language models, prompting techniques, retrieval, and tool integration

 - Contribute to automated tests and documentation for the components you develop

 - Investigate issues, analyse results, and suggest improvements to your team

 - Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team rituals

You will receive regular guidance from your mentor and teammates. The scope of your work will grow progressively as you become familiar with the codebase, the tools, and the technical challenges.


WHO YOU ARE

Before you read on, if you do not have the exact profile described below but feel that this internship matches your skills and interests, we still encourage you to apply.

You will be a great fit if you:

 - Are in the final year of a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field

 - Have basic experience with Python through coursework, personal projects, research, or previous internships

 - Have a basic understanding of programming concepts, data structures, and software development

 - Are curious about artificial intelligence and interested in understanding how AI systems work

 - Are comfortable communicating in English, both written and spoken

It would be fantastic if you:

 - Have worked on a project involving machine learning, natural language processing, or large language models

 - Have used agentic frameworks like Langchain or Google ADK.

 - Have experimented with AI APIs, prompting, retrieval, or conversational interfaces

 - Have experience in taking products to production and supporting them with real users.

 - Have some experience with Git, APIs, testing, or data analysis

 - Have an interest in healthcare, privacy, or responsible AI


LIFE AT DOCTOLIB TECH

Our products are built on a cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile applications across several countries and healthcare systems.

Even if Doctolib uses technologies like Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, React Native, and many cloud-related technologies, the principal language you'll work on is Python.You will also have the opportunity to use AI-assisted development tools within our engineering practices.

Discover our AI vision here https://careers.doctolib.com/ai-careers/ and learn more about our tech culture on the Doctolib Tech site https://careers.doctolib.com/tech-doctolib/.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A structured internship with dedicated mentoring

 - The opportunity to work on real AI projects in a healthcare environment

 - Technical learning sessions and access to internal engineering communities

 - Access to AI tools for coding, development, and learning

 - Meal vouchers

 - Free breakfast in the office

 - Up to 2 days of remote work per week

 - A flexible workplace policy, depending on the team and location

 - A collaborative and international working environment


THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Coding Game

 - Recruiter Interview

 - Technical Interview

 - Behavioral Interview


JOB DETAILS

 - Internship, 6 months, full-time

 - Location: Berlin, Paris, Nantes, Milan, or Amsterdam

 - Hybrid work setup, up to 2 remote days per week

 - Start date: March 2027


WE WELCOME EVERYONE

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. We evaluate candidates based on their qualifications, motivation, and potential, without discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the better our products can serve patients and healthcare professionals. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin.

To support an inclusive recruitment process, we invite you to leave personal information such as pictures and age off your application. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!


YOUR DATA PRIVACY

All information provided through this application is processed by Doctolib for recruitment purposes. For more information about how Doctolib processes your application data, please consult the relevant privacy policy:

 - Germany https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-DE

 - France https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR

 - Italy https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-IT

 - The Netherlands https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-COM

For questions or to exercise your rights, please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com http://doctolib.com/.

title: Anti Financial Crime Internship - French Speaker 🇫🇷
desc:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/qonto.com based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture https://qonto.com/en/careers/culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here https://medium.com/qonto-way/the-qonto-way-our-culture-is-our-strategy-90defd4895f9).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre https://www.linkedin.com/in/aprot/ and Steve https://www.linkedin.com/in/steveanavi/, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process https://medium.com/qonto-way/a-recruiters-dilemma-confronting-bias-in-hiring-b78acce148eb because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here https://medium.com/qonto-way/ai-at-qonto-vision-statement-725a7e2f659b) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Join our Anti-Financial Crime Unit as an AFCU Intern to help shape Qonto's regulatory standing and protect our users. You will report to Garance https://hire.lever.co/jobs/postings/edit/GARANCE_LINKEDIN_URL, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Unit (France).



➡️ What you'll do

 - Investigate & report: Draft high-quality Enhanced Investigations (EIs) and Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) for Tracfin, covering AML, tax fraud, and private scams cases.

 - Handle escalated alerts: Take ownership of cases escalated by our first line of defence teams, identifying money laundering patterns and fraud attempts with precision.

 - Be part of projects to enhance our capacities to detect suspicious behaviours.


➡️ What we're looking for

 - Fluent French writer: You write in French at C2 level — flawless spelling, grammar, and syntax are essential because your reports go directly to French authorities.

 - Legal or financial background: You hold or are currently enrolled in a Master's in Law (Business Law, Criminal Law, Compliance) or Banking/Finance.

 - Detail-oriented mindset: You will be able to synthesize complex transaction patterns into clear, concise written reports under a short time, without sacrificing accuracy.

 - Eager to learn and grow: You welcome feedback, learn fast, and want to build deep expertise in a demanding, regulated environment.


➡️ What you can expect:

 - Work in a fast-paced and scaling environment.

 - Be the second-line protection on all AML-CFT-related topics.

 - Work closely with various teams in an international environment.

 

➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Garance https://hire.lever.co/jobs/postings/edit/GARANCE_LINKEDIN_URL, our Lead Anti-Financial Crime Unit (France).

 

 - Her path? Garance holds a Master's in Criminal Law and Criminal Sciences, and joined Qonto in 2023. She progressed rapidly through Junior and Senior Officer roles before being promoted to Lead — a track record built on both technical depth and team results.

 - What does she bring to the team? Garance is a hands-on manager who values transparency and gives her team genuine autonomy. She's committed to each person's development and looks for people who are as focused on quality as they are on speed.



Perks

 - Flex your schedule. Work from home up to 2 days a week with our hybrid policy.

 - Stay active. Gympass gives you access to 3,000+ sports and wellness partners.

 - Eat well. Lunch card, 50% on us.

 - Get around. 50% of the cost of your public transportation pass is covered.

 - Enjoy the rest. Team events, snacks, and beverages.

 - Take time off. 1 paid day off per month, no questions asked.

 - Be yourself. An inclusive, supportive environment where everyone belongs.




[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.



[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here https://qonto.com/en/careers/candidate-journey



[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice https://qonto.com/en/legal-documents/privacy-notice for full details.



🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to support@qonto.com.
